title: Healing from Past Trauma
cardText: For those whose history — childhood wounds, old harm, things never spoken aloud — still shapes the present.
whatThisFeelsLike: [DRAFT — Matthew to rewrite in his own words] It happened years ago, but it doesn't feel finished. It shows up in your relationships, your reactions, your sense of what you deserve — and you've never told anyone the whole story.
howWeWork: Trauma work here never forces the story out of you. Using CBT and EFT, sessions build safety and stability first, then work through what happened at a pace you control — including how much you say and when. The goal is that the past becomes something that happened to you, not something that runs you. In person in West Chester or by telehealth anywhere in Ohio.
